channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Is China seeking to copy Iran’s Strait of Hormuz blockade around Taiwan?
item.description: Taiwan has long prepared for a Chinese military invasion but wars in Iran and Ukraine expose new potential threats.

item.title: Aftermath of deadly Indonesia earthquake
item.description: Dozens of people have been killed after a 7.7-magnitude earthquake off Indonesia’s Flores Island.

item.title: World Cup winner Ferran Torres joins Paris Saint-Germain from Barcelona
item.description: The 26-year-old striker cost the Ligue 1 champions a reported 50 million euros ($58m) and has signed a five-year deal.

item.title: At scene of deadly Israeli strike on Lebanon home
item.description: An overnight Israeli strike on a family home in Ansar, southern Lebanon, killed at least seven people.

item.title: A Syrian intervention in Lebanon would be too costly for Damascus
item.description: Despite pressure from the US to intervene against Hezbollah, the Syrian government is unlikely to do so.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill nine in southern Lebanon as attacks intensify
item.description: Deadliest Israeli attack in Lebanon since June agreements significantly reduced hostilities.

item.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
item.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as an earlier action against its soldiers.

item.title: Activists try to deliver aid to Palestinians in homes besieged by Israeli settlers
item.description: Two families have been trapped in their homes in the occupied West Bank for several days.
